assets.name: lecture_05_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed floor-and-ceiling fifth-dimensional picture, with the central horizon-bearing lump spreading along the lower boundary.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The gravitational field pulls it down and spreads it out.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed garage-limousine spacetime diagram after both sets of worldlines and simultaneity slices have been drawn.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: That is the Lorentz-contracted length of the limousine.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: The column-vector rotation, explicit three-by-three matrix, and indexed transformation are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: A vector is equal to a matrix times a vector.
assets.caption_hint: Spatial rotation in matrix and index notation

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows the complete four-by-four boost matrix acting on the spatial-first coordinate column.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: A Lorentz transformation can be written as a matrix.
assets.caption_hint: Lorentz boost as a four-by-four matrix

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed composed-boost matrix and the relativistic velocity-addition result without lecturer occlusion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The answer for the combined velocity is u plus v over one plus uv.
assets.caption_hint: Composed boosts and relativistic velocity addition

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Shows all four proper-velocity components in terms of ordinary velocity and the Lorentz factor.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: These are the four components of the relativistic velocity vector.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows a Euclidean curve, differential displacement, arc-length element, and normalized tangent components together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Can you see why this tangent vector is a unit vector?
assets.caption_hint: Euclidean unit tangent as an analogy for four-velocity

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the low-velocity expansion of relativistic energy at the point where rest energy and Newtonian kinetic energy are identified.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: It is mc squared plus one half mv squared.
